article_content: Seoul, South Korea (CNN) -- North Korean and South Korean military forces exchanged gunfire near their border Friday, according to South Korean authorities. No casualties were reported. The incident occurred after North Korean troops fired two rounds from a 14.5mm machine gun at a South Korean guard post near Chorwon, approximately 118 km northeast of Seoul. A Joint Chiefs of Staff official stated that South Korean forces responded with three warning shots from a .50-caliber machine gun and issued loudspeaker warnings. The demilitarized zone in the area spans 1.3 kilometers. Chorwon was a major battleground during the 1950-53 Korean War. This exchange follows North Korea's Friday threat to retaliate against South Korea for declining bilateral military talks. The incident is not expected to affect planned family reunions at Mount Kumgang, the inter-Korean resort, beginning Saturday. Yonhap reported North Korea requested unprecedented rice and fertilizer shipments in exchange for reunion concessions. While border incidents occur periodically, the Yellow Sea maritime border remains the peninsula's most volatile area, with fatal naval clashes in 1999 and 2002. A March 2010 sinking of a South Korean vessel, attributed to a North Korean torpedo by international investigators, resulted in 46 deaths. North Korea denies involvement. The incident precedes the November 11-12 G20 summit in Seoul, where 50,000 police officers will be deployed according to Yonhap. Journalist Andrew Salmon contributed to this report.

Demilitarizirana zona na tom području široka je 1,3 kilometra. Chorwon je bio poprište žestokih bitaka tijekom Korejskog rata (1950-1953). Ovaj događaj uslijedio je nakon petkovih prijetnji Sjeverne Koreje o odmazdi zbog Južnokorejskog odbijanja vojnih pregovora. Incident neće utjecati na planirana obiteljska okupljanja koja počinju u subotu na planini Kumgang, zajedničkom turističkom resortu. Prema Yonhapovim izvješćima, Sjeverna Koreja zatražila je rekordne količine riže i gnojiva kao uvjet za sudjelovanje u okupljanjima. Potapanje južnokorejskog broda Cheonan 2010. godine, koje su međunarodni istražitelji pripisali sjevernokorejskom torpedu, uzrokovalo je 46 smrtnih slučajeva. Sjeverna Koreja i dalje poriče umiješanost. article_content: An Australian man has narrowly avoided capital punishment for the second time in Malaysia's courts this week. Dominic Bird, 34 from Perth, saw his acquittal reaffirmed by the Court of Appeal regarding 2012 drug trafficking allegations involving 167 grams of methamphetamine. The ruling came after prosecutors' last-minute attempt to overturn his initial September 2022 exoneration, which had been granted when the Kuala Lumpur High Court dismissed key police testimony. Malaysian law mandates automatic death sentences for possession exceeding 50 grams of illegal drugs. Bird's legal team successfully argued that undercover officer Luther Nurjib fabricated evidence, with a unanimous panel of three appellate judges concurring that the prosecution's case relied on discredited testimony. 'The credibility of your primary witness has been thoroughly undermined,' Justice Aziah Ali remarked during proceedings. Despite the victory, authorities retain a 14-day window to file a final appeal. Bird, who already served 18 months in detention, stated: 'I'm cautiously optimistic but prepared for any further challenges.' His lawyer highlighted constitutional concerns about Bird's airport re-arrest minutes after initial acquittal, though the court upheld the legality of this action. The case's turning point came when two witnesses provided conflicting accounts about who brought the drugs to the Kuala Lumpur café meeting. This inconsistency, combined with the judges' assessment of Inspector Luther as 'completely unreliable,' ultimately secured Bird's temporary freedom pending potential further appeals.

article_content: Twitter's San Francisco headquarters is integrating two preserved 19th-century log cabins as employee dining spaces within its Market Street office. These historic structures, originally built by Montana homesteaders in the 1880s, were dismantled and transported 1,300 miles after being acquired through Craigslist by Lundberg Design. The architectural firm incorporated the authentic wood structures into a nature-themed office design that references Twitter's bird branding. The renovated cabins now include modern amenities like digital displays and refreshment stations while preserving their original character. This office redesign supports San Francisco's Mid-Market revitalization program, which offers tax incentives to businesses occupying the previously underdeveloped area. Additional campus features include recreational spaces and sustainability-focused installations.

article_content: By Stephanie Darrall | Updated 8:40 AM, 24th October 2011 SNP leader Alex Salmond proposed 'Devolution Max' as a potential third option for Scotland's constitutional future during a party conference in Inverness. This model would grant expanded self-governance while maintaining UK membership, though Salmond emphasized it doesn't match full independence benefits. The First Minister asserted that only Scottish voters should decide their political future, warning Westminster against interference. He criticized UK coalition ministers for allegedly attempting to block independence while reducing Scotland's budget by £16 billion and benefiting from North Sea oil revenues. Salmond described Devolution Max as 'necessary but insufficient,' noting it would leave Trident nuclear missiles in Scottish waters and exclude Scotland from European and global decision-making bodies. Quoting Irish nationalist Charles Stewart Parnell, he declared: 'No London politician will determine Scotland's future.' An independence referendum is scheduled for the end of the current parliamentary term, with Salmond vowing to campaign vigorously for full sovereignty. He accused London of already gaining £300 million from Scottish resources and pledged independence would redirect these profits to Scotland.

Škotski prvi ministar naglasio je da isključivo škotski građani imaju pravo odlučivati o političkoj budućnosti, upozorivši Westminster da se suzdrži od miješanja. article_content: NEW YORK (CNN) -- Five years after Carrie Bradshaw's Paris journey in the 'Sex and the City' finale, Sarah Jessica Parker reflects on bringing the characters back for the film. As both star and producer, Parker told CNN's A.J. Hammer about the challenging two-year production process she describes as 'a once-in-a-lifetime experience.' The 2006 table read marked a significant reunion. 'Coordinating schedules was complex,' Parker noted, with co-stars Kim Cattrall, Kristin Davis, and Chris Noth managing other commitments. She called the first day on set 'a privilege,' crediting director Michael Patrick King's vision. Responding to rumors of cast discord, Parker stated: 'After 35 years in this industry, I focus on my work ethic and relationships. This project required all four lead actors - we couldn't have done it without any of them.' On balancing fame and family life in New York, Parker explained: 'We choose to live authentically - shopping ourselves, using public transit. It keeps us connected to reality.' Regarding the franchise's future, she deferred to audiences: 'We've accomplished what we set out to do. What happens next depends on the viewers.'

article_content: Researchers from two international teams have made a breakthrough in understanding H5N1 avian influenza's replication process. Their studies, published in Nature, reveal a specific protein crucial to the virus's ability to multiply - potentially opening new avenues for drug development. While human infections remain rare, the virus maintains its deadly potential with a 63% fatality rate among the 404 confirmed human cases reported since 2003. Recent reports from China's health authorities show eight infections and four deaths last month alone. Current antiviral medications Tamiflu and Relenza remain effective but face resistance challenges. 'All influenza viruses eventually develop some resistance,' explains Dr. Anthony Fauci of the U.S. National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases. 'Our goal is to minimize this through strategic treatment approaches.' Global health agencies maintain pandemic preparedness plans including vaccine stockpiles. However, developing targeted treatments requires precise knowledge of circulating strains. Scientists emphasize containment of animal outbreaks as the first line of defense against potential human transmission.

Iako su ljudske infekcije rijetke, virus ostaje opasan sa stopom smrtnosti od 63% među 404 potvrđena slučaja od 2003. godine. Prema nedavnim podacima kineskog Ministarstva zdravstva, zabilježeno je osam oboljelih i četiri smrtna slučaja u prošlom mjesecu. Trenutno korišteni lijekovi Tamiflu i Relenza još uvijek djeluju, ali virus razvija otpornost. 'Kod svih virusa influence se s vremenom razvije otpornost,' objašnjava dr. article_content: A North Naples resident encountered three American black bears in her backyard pool on December 16, 2013. TJ Ozbay recorded the wildlife visit after the animals circumvented screen barriers surrounding her Florida property. The bears remained on site for approximately one hour, with one approaching home entry points. While black bears (Ursus americanus) typically avoid humans, adults can weigh up to 550 pounds. Historical records document 23 fatal encounters between 1900-1980. Ozbay suggested running water from a hose may have attracted the animals. Authorities from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission responded but didn't require intervention as the bears left voluntarily. Wildlife experts emphasize securing food sources and avoiding confrontation during such encounters. This incident reflects increasing interactions between Florida's growing urban populations and native species habitats.

article_content: Police are searching for a hit-and-run driver who left a seven-year-old boy in critical condition after striking a mother and her two children in Bournemouth, Dorset. The incident occurred as the family crossed a road near a library in Kinson at 5:11 PM on March 5, 2014. Witnesses reported the driver, operating a red Volkswagen Polo with T or Y registration plates, exited the vehicle briefly before leaving the scene. The older child sustained life-threatening injuries and was transported to Poole Hospital, while the younger sibling suffered shock and minor injuries. Authorities describe the driver as a white woman aged 40-50, approximately 5ft 3in tall, with shoulder-length brown hair. Inspector Steve White of Dorset Police urged witnesses and the driver to come forward.

article_content: When Rachel Miller's son John was diagnosed with severe autism at age 7, conventional approaches failed to connect with him. The nonverbal child withdrew from social interactions, frustrating educators and family alike. In March 2003, therapist Jeff Hancock entered their lives through weekend mall visits in Stuart, Florida, modeling one-sided conversations to build rapport. A breakthrough came through Hancock's Special Olympics involvement in Martin County. Observing John's rare smiles during physical activity, they introduced structured track training. An initial three-year observational phase focused on understanding event logistics before attempting races. Customized coaching helped John master 50-meter sprints by age 15, progressing to hurdling and 800-meter events. Miller recalls the 2014 Special Olympics State Summer Games in Orlando as pivotal: 'As John lined up for the 800-meter final, my anxiety transformed into awe. He wasn't just participating - he was excelling.' The gold medal victory symbolized more than athletic achievement; it demonstrated how tailored coaching could unlock potential where traditional methods fell short. Hancock's approach emphasized completion over competition, using finish-line rewards like hugs and drinks. This positive reinforcement helped mitigate John's self-harming behaviors that intensified during adolescence. While social interactions remained challenging off-track, running became John's primary communication method - his joyful vocalizations during races contrasting sharply with usual silence. Reflecting on their journey, Miller notes: 'Jeff saw athletic potential we never imagined. If John could speak, he'd credit his coach's unwavering belief.' The story challenges assumptions about autism limitations, highlighting how alternative pathways can foster growth.

Prekretnica se dogodila kroz Hancockovo sudjelovanje u Specijalnim olimpijadama u okrugu Martin. Uočivši Johnove rijetke osmijehe tijekom fizičke aktivnosti, odlučili su uvesti strukturirani atletski trening. Početna trogodišnja faza sastojala se od promatranja treninga i natjecanja kako bi John shvatio tok događaja. Prilagođeni pristup pomogao mu je da savlada 50-metarske sprintove do 15. godine, da bi kasnije prešao na prepone i utrke na 800 metara. Nije samo sudjelovao - istaknuo se.' Zlatna medalja nije bila samo sportsko postignuće, već dokaz kako individualizirani pristup može otkriti potencijal tamo gdje tradicionalne metode nisu uspjele. Hancockova metoda naglašavala je važnost završetka utrke umjesto natjecanja, koristeći nagrade kao što su zagrljaji i osvježenje na cilju. Ovakva pozitivna potvrda pomogla je smanjiti Johnove samoopažajne navike koje su se pojačavale tijekom adolescencije. Dok su društvene interakcije izvan atletske staze i dalje bile izazovne, trčanje je postalo Johnov glavni način komunikacije - radosni povici tijekom utrka bili su u oštroj suprotnosti s njegovom uobičajenom šutnjom. Gledajući unatrag, Miller ističe: 'Jeff je vidio sportski potencijal koji mi nismo mogli ni zamisliti. Da John može govoriti, rekao bi da je sve zahvalio trenerovoj nepokolebljivoj vjeri.' Ova priča dovodi u pitanje predrasude o ograničenjima autizma, pokazujući kako alternativni pristupi mogu potaknuti razvoj.

article_content: A wildlife observation in Alaska's Kaktovik region documented polar bear cubs interacting with marine debris. Photographer Michael D. Stern, 70, recorded two juveniles manipulating a section of rope along the coastal ice margin. Over 35 minutes, the cubs exhibited exploratory behavior - chewing, pulling, and temporarily becoming ensnared in the material while their mother rested nearby. The younger bears demonstrated social learning when one assisted the other in disentangling. This progressed to coordinated pulling interactions. Stern captured these natural behaviors from a boat approximately 30 meters offshore during a seven-day field study involving daily 8-10 hour observation sessions. 'The rope appeared to serve as environmental enrichment,' Stern noted. 'While aware of my presence, the bears remained engaged in their social interactions. Documenting these authentic wild behaviors offered valuable insights into Arctic predator development.'

Tijekom 35 minuta promatranja, medvjedići su demonstrirali istraživačko ponašanje - žvakali su, vukli i privremeno se zapetljali u uže dok im se majka odmarala u neposrednoj blizini. Kad se jedan mladunac znao zapetljati, drugi je došao u pomoć, pokazujući razvijene društvene vještine. Ova interakcija prerasla je u koordiniranu igru povlačenja užeta. Stern je ovu prirodnu pojavu snimio s čamca udaljenog oko 30 metara tijekom sedmodnevnog istraživačkog rada koji je uključivao dnevno 8 do 10 sati promatranja. 'Uže je poslužilo kao neobičan element u njihovom okolišu,' komentirao je Stern. 'Iako su svjesni moje prisutnosti, medvjedi su ostali usredotočeni na međusobne interakcije. Dokumentiranje ovakvog autentičnog ponašanja pruža dragocjene uvide u razvoj mladunaca arktičkih grabežljivaca.'

Through online research, Carlina found a 1987 missing child report containing a baby photo resembling her own daughter. DNA tests confirmed her identity on January 4. Relative Lisa White-Heatley described the reunion: 'Her face looked just like herself...my sister cried tears of joy.' Authorities plan federal kidnapping charges upon Pettway's arrest. article_content: Criminal networks are shifting focus to government healthcare systems, with Medicare and Medicaid becoming prime targets for sophisticated fraud operations. Authorities report that groups previously involved in drug trafficking and illegal gambling now find healthcare fraud safer and more lucrative. In Los Angeles, federal agents have uncovered multiple international operations. Recent cases include former Soviet military leader Konstantin Grigoryan's $20 million Medicare theft and Karapet Khacheryan's gang stealing physician credentials for a $2 million scam. Nigerian nationals Christopher Iruke and Connie Ikpoh allegedly defrauded $6 million through fraudulent medical equipment claims. Fraudsters exploit both medical professional and patient data. 'Doctor identities become golden tickets,' explained investigator Glenn Ferry. 'They create phantom clinics using stolen credentials while victims remain unaware.' Psychiatrist Dr. Gianfranco Burdi discovered his license was used to bill $800,000 for unnecessary equipment after nearly joining a suspicious medical practice. Vulnerable populations in areas like Skid Row reportedly sell their Medicare details for quick cash. 'When you're struggling, $100 per clinic visit tempts many,' admitted one participant. These stolen beneficiary numbers enable criminals to submit false claims through shell companies, often using abandoned buildings as fake medical offices. While authorities project recovering $4 billion in fraudulent claims this year, experts note this represents merely 5% of total estimated losses. The honor-based billing system makes healthcare programs particularly vulnerable to exploitation by both organized crime and individual opportunists.

U Los Angelesu su federalni agenti razotkrili više međunarodnih operacija. Nedavni slučajevi uključuju bivšeg sovjetskog pukovnika Konstantina Grigoryana osuđenog za pronevjeru 20 milijuna dolara iz Medicarea te bandu Karapeta 'Doktora' Khacheryana osuđenu za krađu liječničkih identiteta u prijevari vrijednoj 2 milijuna dolara. article_content: A Houston mother faces child abuse charges after allegedly choking her six-year-old son for drinking chocolate milk without permission. article_content: Hardik Pandya has been ruled out of the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup due to a ligament injury sustained during India's match against Bangladesh. article_content: Former Newsnight presenter Jeremy Paxman has revealed he declined an approach to become the Conservative Party's candidate for the 2016 London mayoral race, humorously stating he 'wouldn't accept the role for all the pastries in Paris'. The veteran broadcaster, who self-identifies as a traditional Conservative, confirmed discussions occurred about potentially succeeding Boris Johnson as the Tory nominee. Johnson himself aims to re-enter Parliament through the Uxbridge and South Ruislip constituency while the party seeks viable mayoral candidates. Political circles await confirmation from Labour's Sadiq Khan regarding his potential candidacy, with several party colleagues including Tottenham MP David Lammy and Olympic organizer Tessa Jowell already declaring their intentions. Conservative businessman Ivan Massow remains the sole declared Tory hopeful at this stage. article_content: CANBERRA, Australia -- Three murderers are among 81 foreigners recently released in Australia after the High Court ruled their indefinite detention in migrant centers was unconstitutional, Immigration Minister Andrew Giles said Tuesday. The court hasn't disclosed reasons for overturning a 2004 precedent allowing indefinite detention of stateless individuals. The Melbourne-based Human Rights Law Center reported last month that 127 detainees had been held over five years, with an average detention period of 709 days. The government opposed releasing foreign detainees unwanted by Australia and unaccepted by other nations. Opposition lawmakers labeled them 'hardcore criminals,' alleging public endangerment. Giles confirmed released individuals include three murderers and multiple sex offenders, offering opposition deputy leader Sussan Ley detailed crime statistics. 'The High Court decision requires releasing very serious offenders,' Giles told Parliament. Among those released is Sirul Azhar Umar, a Malaysian ex-police officer sentenced in absentia in 2015 for a murder involving military-grade explosives. Detained nine years in Australia due to extradition restrictions preventing capital punishment cases, he cannot be sent to Malaysia. Details of two other murder convicts remain undisclosed. Ley highlighted Afghan-born Aliyawar Yawari, a 65-year-old convicted of attacking elderly women, now residing in Perth under release conditions. Home Affairs Minister Clare O'Neil stated all released individuals face strict visa requirements, with some requiring daily police check-ins. 'These individuals committed horrific crimes impacting victims still in Australia,' O'Neil said. The landmark case involved a Rohingya refugee (identified as NZYQ) convicted of raping a 10-year-old boy, whose post-prison indefinite detention prompted the court challenge.

Sud nije objavio razloge za poništavanje presude iz 2004. koja je dopuštala neograničeno zadržavanje osoba bez državljanstva. Vlada se protivila puštanju stranih zatočenika koje Australija ne želi primiti, a druge države ne žele prihvatiti. Oporbeni zastupnici nazvali su ih 'tvrdokornim kriminalcima', optužujući vladu za ugrožavanje javne sigurnosti. Giles je potvrdio da među puštenima ima trojice ubojica i više seksualnih prijestupnika, te je ponudio oporbnoj zamjenici čelnice Sussan Ley detaljne statističke podatke o zločinima. article_content: Australian authorities urgently appealed to residents remaining in St. George, Queensland, to evacuate as floodwaters reached record levels. The Balonne River surged to 13.63 meters by midday Monday – surpassing historical records – with predictions of peaking above 14 meters overnight. 'While we respect personal decisions, we strongly advise everyone to evacuate immediately,' stated Queensland Police Commissioner Bob Atkinson. The region continues to grapple with flood impacts while still recovering from catastrophic flooding a year prior. Emergency Services Minister Neil Roberts confirmed 30 homes already flooded, warning numbers will increase as waters rise. Most of St. George's 3,000 residents evacuated via buses and aircraft, with military helicopters and a C-130 cargo plane assisting operations. Tragically, rescue teams recovered Jane Sheahan's body on Sunday after floodwaters swept away her vehicle in Roma. Witnesses reported Sheahan saved her 7-year-old son Darcy by passing him to a rescuer before being carried away. Flood damage has affected hundreds of homes across Roma and Mitchell, while neighboring New South Wales faces ongoing isolation despite some water receding.

'Iako poštujemo osobne odluke, snažno savjetujemo svima da odmah napuste područje,' izjavio je policijski povjerenik Queenslanda Bob Atkinson. Regija se i dalje suočava s posljedicama poplava dok se još oporavlja od katastrofalnih poplava prije godinu dana. article_content: Washington (CNN) – Jordan's King Abdullah II met Tuesday with U.S. President Barack Obama to discuss the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and Syria's ongoing crisis. Following White House talks, both leaders emphasized continued cooperation to revive Middle East peace negotiations, with Abdullah stressing the need to 'remain hopeful' for progress. The Jordanian monarch has increasingly mediated between Israelis and Palestinians since Egypt's political shifts following Hosni Mubarak's 2011 ouster. Earlier this month, Palestinian and Israeli negotiators convened in Amman with Middle East Quartet representatives (United States, European Union, United Nations, Russia) attempting to break a year-long stalemate. While no major breakthroughs occurred, both sides agreed to continue dialogue. Obama praised Abdullah's regional leadership during the Arab Spring transitions that reshaped Egypt and Libya. The U.S. president noted Jordan became the first Arab state to demand Syrian President Bashar al-Assad's resignation over violent crackdowns. Obama commended Jordan's role in Arab League efforts for Syrian political transition, stating: 'We'll maintain close coordination to build international pressure encouraging Syria's regime to step aside, allowing democratic reforms.' Obama also acknowledged Jordan's domestic reforms, stating the U.S. supports 'political and economic changes addressing Jordanians' needs.' King Abdullah thanked America for economic aid, including recent food security assistance, while expressing optimism about reform progress. Outside the White House, Jordan National Movement protesters demonstrated against the monarchy's political system. Israeli-Palestinian negotiations stalled over West Bank settlement disputes. Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas' 2021 UN statehood bid was opposed by Israel as premature without security negotiations. Abdullah recently visited Ramallah and met Israeli President Shimon Peres in renewed diplomatic efforts.

Nakon razgovara u Bijeloj kući, obojica čelnika naglasili su nastavak suradnje za obnovu mirovnih pregovora na Bliskom istoku, pri čemu je Abdullah istaknuo potrebu da 'ostanemo puni nade' za napredak. Iako nije došlo do većih pomaka, obje strane pristale su nastaviti dijalog. Obama je pohvalio Abdullahovu regionalnu ulogu tijekom promjena Arapskog proljeća koje su preoblikovale Egipat i Libiju. Obama je pohvalio Jordanovu ulogu u naporima Arapske lige za političku tranziciju u Siriji, izjavivši: 'Nastavit ćemo blisko koordinirati kako bismo izgradili međunarodni pritisak koji potiče sirijski režim da odstupi, omogućavajući demokratske reforme.' article_content: (CNN) -- The danger of electrocution from 1,500-volt lines and falls from moving trains hasn't deterred commuters. Thousands continue riding overloaded trains daily in Jakarta. Starting Monday, Indonesian railway officials will combat rooftop riders with colored dye spray, according to the Jakarta Post. The state transit agency describes this as a 'unique approach' to prevent illegal rooftop travel. Trains remain the most affordable and efficient transport for workers commuting between Jakarta and nearby areas. During rush hours, overcrowding forces many passengers onto train roofs. Under new protocols, security personnel will mark offenders with dye as trains depart stations. Officials at destinations can then easily identify them through the markings. 'We'll confiscate IDs and issue tickets,' said Kerata Api spokesman Akhmand Sujadi. 'Copies will be sent to their families, local community leaders, employers, or school administrators.' Offenders must write apology letters approved by ticket recipients to reclaim their identification. The system transported over 320,000 daily commuters last year, generating 248 billion Rupiah ($26.8 million). Many riders choose rooftops due to overcrowding or inability to pay fares starting at 1,000 Rupiah ($0.11). At least 53 rooftop riders died in accidents over the past two years.

Od ponedjeljka će indonežanske željezničke vlasti koristiti obojenu boju za sprječavanje putovanja na krovovima vlakova, prema izvješću Jakarta Posta. Državni prijevoznički servis ovu metodu opisuje kao 'jedinstven pristup' za sprječavanje nezakonitog putovanja na krovovima. Vlakovi ostaju najjeftiniji i najučinkovitiji prijevoz za radnike koji putuju između Jakarte i okolnih gradova. Tijekom jutarnje i večernje špice, gužve prisiljavaju mnoge putnike na putovanje na krovovima. Prema novim mjerama, osiguranje će obilježiti prekršitelje bojom dok vlakovi napuštaju stanice. Službenici na odredištu mogu ih onda lako prepoznati po obilježjima. 'Oduzet ćemo osobne iskaznice i izdati kazne', izjavio je glasnogovornik Kerata Apija Akhmand Sujadi. 'Kopije kazni poslat ćemo obiteljima, predstavnicima mjesnih zajednica, poslodavcima ili ravnateljima škola.' Prekršitelji mogu povratiti dokumente nakon pisanja izjava o ponašanju koje mora potvrditi primatelj kazne. Sustav je prošle godine dnevno prevozio preko 320.000 putnika, ostvarivši prihod od 248 milijardi rupija (26,8 milijuna USD). Mnogi putnici biraju krovove zbog nedostatka mjesta unutar vagona ili nemogućnosti plaćanja karte koja počinje od 1.000 rupija (0,11 USD). Najmanje 53 putnika na krovovima poginulo je u posljednje dvije godine, prema podacima izvora.

article_content: Three-year-old Ellison Susman died Monday, two days after being found unconscious in a hot tub during a neighborhood gathering in Laguna Hills. The incident occurred at approximately 8:00 PM on Saturday at Alicia Plaza Apartments. According to Orange County Sheriff's Department spokesman Jim Amormino, the child had been unsupervised for about 15 minutes before discovery. Father Ernie Susman stated Ellison was wearing a life preserver that she unfastened prior to entering the hot tub. Emergency responders performed CPR before transporting her to Kaiser Irvine Medical Center and later Children's Hospital of Orange County, where she succumbed to her injuries. A memorial has grown at the apartment complex, with neighbors leaving flowers and tributes. 'She was just an awesome kid,' Susman told reporters. 'I'm going to miss that.'

Incident se dogodio u subotu oko 20:00 sati u apartmanskom kompleksu Alicia Plaza. Prema izjavi Jima Amormina, glasnogovornika šerifova ureda okruga Orange, djevojčica je bila bez nadzora oko 15 minuta prije pronalaska. Otac Ernie Susman objasnio je da je Ellison imala spasilački prsluk koji je sama otkopčala prije ulaska u kadu. Hitna pomoć izvela je oživljavanje prije nego što su je prevezli u medicinski centar Kaiser Irvine, a zatim u Dječju bolnicu okruga Orange, gdje je preminula. Na mjestu nesreće susjedi su ostavljali cvijeće i poruke sućuti. 'Bila je nevjerojatno posebno dijete,' rekao je Susman novinarima. 'Nedostajat će mi.'

article_content: By Victoria Woollaston. More than 7.5 million children under 13 circumvent Facebook's age restrictions. In 2012, the social network filed a patent proposing parental-authorized accounts for minors, though this application only became public last week. Child advocates have criticized the proposal, while Facebook maintains the patent doesn't indicate policy changes. The system would require parental verification through existing accounts, enabling adults to monitor and control children's activities. Facebook stated to MailOnline: 'A patent isn't a predictor of future work.' Current age limits comply with the 1998 Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), requiring Federal Trade Commission approval for changes. Previous criticism emerged in October when Facebook allowed teen users to make public posts. A 2012 Consumer Reports study found over 5 million children under 10 using Facebook, a figure reportedly consistent since then.

Zagovornici dječjih prava kritizirali su ideju, dok Facebook naglašava da patent ne predviđa stvarne promjene. Sustav bi zahtijevao roditeljsku potvrdu putem postojećih profila, dajući odraslima mogućnost nadzora nad dječjim aktivnostima. Facebook je za MailOnline izjavio: 'Patent ne označava planirane promjene.' Trenutna dobna granica od 13 godina pridržava se Zakona o online zaštiti dječje privatnosti (COPPA) iz 1998., a bilo kakve promjene zahtijevaju odobrenje Federalne trgovinske komisije. article_content: An Atlanta mother of eight narrowly avoided homelessness after a Good Samaritan intervened. Lyna McNeil rented a home for $750/month from 'Shawn,' whose contact details she found on a neighborhood sign. Three weeks later, Mr. Carr arrived asserting legal ownership and demanding immediate eviction. McNeil told WSB-TV: 'I offered rent payments and security deposits, but he declined.' The family spent a night protecting their possessions in their car while Animal Control removed their dogs due to lack of shelter. Neighbors described the McNeils as respectful tenants, with one noting: 'The house stood empty for years before they moved in.' Following local news coverage, an anonymous donor provided a four-bedroom home rent-free. McNeil responded: 'Thank you so much. God bless you.' Court records confirm Carr filed an intruder affidavit through Fulton County Superior Court, with sheriff's deputies supervising the eviction process.

article_content: The UK's Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) has significantly revised its housing market forecasts, predicting steeper price increases than previously anticipated. Revised projections indicate average house prices will rise by 5.2% in 2014, 7.2% in 2015, and remain 10% above March 2013 forecasts by 2018. Chancellor George Osborne acknowledged housing supply shortages while announcing measures to boost construction, including a £300 million increase in council borrowing limits and expanded 'Right to Buy' programs. The OBR forecasts stamp duty revenues will nearly double from £8.9 billion (2013/14) to £16.8 billion (2018/19), with rising prices pushing more transactions into higher tax brackets. While supporting homeownership initiatives, Osborne emphasized the Bank of England's new authority to intervene against potential market bubbles.

Ažurirane projekcije ukazuju na porast prosječnih cijena kuća od 5.2% u 2014., 7.2% u 2015., te 10% iznad ožujskih prognoza iz 2013. do 2018. godine. Ministar financija George Osborne priznao je nedostatke u ponudi stanova, istovremeno najavljujući mjere za poticanje gradnje - uključujući povećanje zajmovnog limita za lokalne vlasti od 300 milijuna funti i proširenje programa 'Pravo na kupovinu'. OBR predviđa da će prihodi od poreza na promet nekretnina skoro udvostručiti s 8.9 milijardi funti (2013./14.) na 16.8 milijardi funti (2018./19.), pri čemu rastuće cijene guraju više transakcija u više porezne razrede. article_content: The Royal Fleet Auxiliary vessel Wave Knight intercepted a boat carrying £1 million worth of marijuana in the Caribbean during a multinational counter-narcotics operation. On 26 December, the ship pursued the suspect vessel Miss Kameney, enabling US Coast Guard officers to board and discover 250kg of cannabis concealed in storage sacks. Five crew members were detained and transferred to US authorities in the Dominican Republic. This marks Wave Knight's second major drug interdiction during its year-long regional deployment, conducted in coordination with HMS Lancaster and international partners to disrupt Caribbean drug networks. Defence Secretary Philip Hammond praised the crew's efforts during the holiday period: 'This operation highlights our personnel's crucial role in preventing dangerous drugs from reaching streets worldwide.' The seizure adds to Wave Knight's 2013 total of three tonnes of intercepted narcotics, while HMS Lancaster confiscated 1.2 tonnes of marijuana and 400kg of cocaine prior to returning to its Portsmouth base. The mission supported Operation Martillo, a 15-nation collaborative effort targeting drug trafficking routes from South America through the Caribbean. RFA Wave Knight, operated by the UK Ministry of Defence with a mixed crew of 77 civilian personnel and a US law enforcement team, remains vital to regional security operations.

Dana 26. prosinca, brod je pratio sumnjivi teretnjak Miss Kameney, omogućivši pripadnicima američke obalne straže da uđu na brod i pronađu 250 kg skrivene marihuane u vrećama. article_content: Mojave Food Corporation has initiated a voluntary recall of 60 packages of El Guapo Nuez Entera/Shelled Walnuts (1-ounce packages, UPC 4498933144, date code 5527) sold exclusively in Southern California. This precautionary measure follows a supplier notification about potential salmonella contamination, though no related illnesses have been reported. Consumers in possession of affected products should dispose of them immediately and contact Mojave's customer service at 1-800-995-8906 ext. 114 for replacement or reimbursement. Salmonella infections typically cause diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps within days of exposure. While most cases resolve without treatment, certain antibiotic-resistant strains may require medical intervention. The National Institutes of Health notes that young children, elderly individuals, and immunocompromised persons face higher risks of severe complications.

Potrošači koji su kupili ove proizvode trebaju ih odmah uništiti i kontaktirati korisničku službu na 1-800-995-8906 ext. 114 radi zamjene ili nadoknade. article_content: A London private school faces scrutiny after a student was killed in Rio de Janeiro during an educational trip. Sergei Petrovich Danshin, 17, son of a Russian business executive, was fatally shot in what authorities describe as an execution-style killing. The incident occurred within 48 hours of the group's arrival in Brazil, with police confirming the victim left his accommodation seeking cannabis. Four students and staff from the £22,000-per-year International Community School were staying at a beachside villa. Despite the violent nature of the crime, investigators noted Sergei's iPhone and credit card remained untouched. Headteacher Philip Hurd accompanied the group, though questions arose about supervision after local reports of underage alcohol consumption. Bar owner Renan Magalhaes Garcia Gutierrez stated Sergei returned alone to inquire about cannabis availability hours before his death. 'I warned him it was dangerous, but he dismissed my concerns,' Gutierrez recalled. The victim's father has traveled to Brazil seeking answers, while the school expressed condolences and pledged full cooperation with authorities.

article_content: By Ian Laybourn, PA Media. Hull FC captain Gareth Ellis has signed a contract extension keeping him at the KC Stadium until 2016. The 33-year-old former England international returned from Australia's NRL three years ago, signing a three-year deal with the Airlie Birds. Despite having 12 months remaining on his current contract, the second-row forward aims to improve Hull's performance after missing 2014 play-offs. 'It's been a challenging year but the club shows clear progress,' Ellis stated. 'We've strengthened the squad, coaches are dedicated, and chairman Adam Pearson remains fully committed. I aim to justify the club's faith in me.' Ellis added: 'This extension reflects my belief in continuing beyond 2016.' Coach Lee Radford praised Ellis: 'Gareth's leadership and form deserve better results than this season delivered.' New signings include Australian Mark Minichiello and half-backs Leon Pryce and Marc Sneyd. Radford confirmed: 'We're still pursuing one or two more recruits through positive negotiations.'

article_content: A new DNA tagging system resembling a high-tech water pistol could revolutionize crime prevention. Developed by UK-based Selectamark, the High Velocity DNA Tagging System fires soft green pellets containing synthetic DNA up to 40 meters. Unlike conventional weapons, these pellets mark suspects without causing harm, leaving traceable evidence that lasts weeks. The system features UV-reactive DNA codes unique to each pellet batch. 'This allows authorities to conclusively link suspects to specific incidents days or weeks later,' explained Selectamark's Andrew Knights. The marking solution penetrates clothing and adheres to skin, providing dual forensic evidence. Police can use pistol or shotgun-style launchers firing 20 rounds per load. The technology proves particularly useful for crowd control and suspect pursuit situations. Selectamark recently demonstrated the system in Nevada, reporting strong global interest from law enforcement agencies. A Nelson, Lancashire pilot program using DNA marking saw burglaries eliminated among 600 participating households during the trial period. McDonald's Australia adopted similar technology, installing DNA spray systems in 700 stores following holiday season robberies. Each DNA code remains secure through police-verified encrypted databases, requiring special authorization for decryption. The non-toxic pellets include UV tracers for suspect identification under specialized lamps.

'High Velocity DNA Tagging System' ispaljuje mekane zelene kuglice sa sintetičkom DNK na udaljenost do 40 metara. Za razliku od uobičajenog oružja, kuglice označe osumnjičenike bez ozljeda, ostavljajući tragove koji traju tjednima. Sustav koristi UV-reaktivne DNK kodove jedinstvene za svaku seriju. 'Ovo omogućuje vlastima da nedvojbeno povežu osumnjičenike sa specifičnim incidentima danima ili tjednima kasnije,' objasnio je Andrew Knights iz Selectamarka. Oznaka prodire kroz odjeću i prianja za kožu, pružajući dvostruki forenzički dokaz. Policija može koristiti pištolje ili sačmarice s 20 metaka po punjenju. article_content: Eight puppies narrowly escaped fatal circumstances after being abandoned in a bin during extreme temperatures near Orpington, Kent. A vigilant driver discovered the distressed animals on Friday afternoon when outdoor temperatures reached 32°C, the highest recorded this year. The rescuer transported the crossbreed pups to Foal Farm Animal Rescue Centre, where staff named them after confectionery items reflecting their gentle dispositions. Shelter manager Debra Taylor recounted: 'The caller sounded distraught when reporting the roadside discovery. Upon arrival, the puppies showed clear signs of heat exhaustion and dehydration. We immediately moved them to a temperature-controlled environment and began rehydration protocols. This level of disregard for animal welfare is unconscionable - they could've easily perished without intervention.' Kennel supervisor Sarah Mitchell noted the deliberate placement of the bin in a traffic lane, increasing collision risks. 'While we regularly receive abandoned animals, this calculated cruelty shocks even experienced staff. The puppies lack microchips, making owner identification impossible. This appears rooted in irresponsible breeding practices rather than accidental loss.' Mitchell emphasized accessible alternatives: 'Shelters exist precisely for these situations. We provide safety, medical care, and adoption services regardless of capacity challenges. There's never justification for such dangerous abandonment.'

Upraviteljica skloništa Debra Taylor izjavila je: 'Pozivatelj je zvučao jako uznemireno prilikom prijave pronalaska uz cestu. Štenad je po dolasku pokazivala znakove pregrevanja i dehidracije. Nedostatak čipova onemogućio je identifikaciju vlasnika. Čini se da je problem u neodgovornom uzgoju, a ne slučajnom gubitku.' Mitchell je naglasila dostupna rješenja: 'Skloništa postoje upravo zbog ovakvih situacija. Pružamo sigurnost, veterinarsku skrb i priliku za udomljavanje unatoč prepunim kapacitetima. article_content: Katy Orr, a 17-year-old from Ayrshire with 20% vision in her left eye and complete blindness in her right, confronts systemic barriers while pursuing her teaching aspirations. The absence of formal transition protocols between her school and chosen university threatens to derail her academic journey. Scotland currently lacks legal mandates for disabled students' transition plans, though Compass Pro guidelines outline recommended preparations six months pre-graduation. While the Co-ordinated Support Plan (CSP) carries legal weight, its adoption remains inconsistent across institutions. Statistics reveal stark disparities: young disabled individuals face fourfold higher unemployment rates by age 25 compared to peers. Pam Duncan-Glancy MSP, who uses a wheelchair, has personal experience with these challenges, having delayed her own university start due to inadequate support planning. Enable Scotland's Stepping Up initiative, operational in 100 schools, bridges education-to-work transitions through internships and skill development. At Glasgow's St Oswald's School, specialized college programs begin in S4 to accommodate diverse needs. Government commitments include a forthcoming National Transitions Strategy, while local councils emphasize collaborative planning with families and post-school institutions to improve outcomes.

U srednjoj školi St Oswald's u Glasgowu specijalizirani programi pripreme za fakultet počinju već u četvrtom razredu kako bi odgovorili različitim potrebama učenika. article_content: British parliamentary investigators have formally summoned media mogul Rupert Murdoch, his son James, and former News of the World editor Rebekah Brooks to testify about the phone hacking scandal. This follows allegations by former Prime Minister Gordon Brown that Murdoch's media group illegally obtained his private information. The Culture, Media and Sport Committee set the hearing for July 19. News International stated senior executives would cooperate without specifying names. Parliamentary rules allow compelling attendance if necessary, as noted by Labour MP Chris Bryant, who believes he was also targeted. Committee chair John Whittingdale emphasized the need to address prior misleading testimony: 'We must identify who provided false information to Parliament and what exactly was fabricated.' The government concurrently plans to support a motion opposing News Corp's BSkyB acquisition. Brown accused The Sunday Times of accessing his legal files, though the outlet defended its reporting as public-interest journalism. Domain registrations suggest News International may launch a Sunday edition of The Sun following News of the World's closure. Metropolitan Police faced intense scrutiny during hearings, with Assistant Commissioner John Yates admitting his 2009 decision to halt investigations was flawed. Lawmakers questioned why evidence remained unexamined and raised corruption concerns within the police force. Investigations revealed decade-long efforts to obtain Brown's financial and family medical information during his ministerial roles. News International denied wrongdoing, citing a cystic fibrosis patient's account as their story's basis. Despite closing News of the World, the crisis continues impacting Murdoch's empire, with News Corp announcing $5 billion in stock buybacks amid declining share prices. The scandal threatens the stability of one of Britain's most influential media conglomerates.

Zastupnici su ispitivali zašto dokazi u vrećama u Scotland Yardu nisu pregledani te istaknuli moguću korupciju među policajcima. Istrage su otkrile desetogodišnje pokušaje prikupljanja Brownovih financijskih podataka i informacija o zdravstvenom stanju njegova sina tijekom njegovih mandata premijera i ministra financija. Unatoč zatvaranju News of the World, kriza i dalje potresa Murdochov medijski imperij. News Corp je najavio otkup 5 milijardi dolara vlastitih dionica nakon pada vrijednosti. article_content: Afghanistan's deadliest earthquake in recent years has killed over 2,000 people according to Taliban authorities, with emergency services reporting 9,240 injured and 1,329 homes damaged or destroyed. The disaster struck 35 kilometers northwest of Herat city on Saturday, registering 6.3 magnitude according to the U.S. Geological Survey. Conflicting casualty figures emerged throughout the crisis, beginning with 16 deaths reported Saturday night before escalating sharply. By Sunday, Disaster Ministry spokesperson Mullah Janan Sayeeq confirmed 2,053 fatalities to Reuters. Local health official Dr. Danish revealed over 200 bodies had been transported to medical facilities, noting women and children comprised most victims. Emergency crews repurposed military bases as temporary morgues to handle the overwhelming casualties. Herat resident Naseema described the chaos via text message: 'Everyone abandoned their homes – we're all sheltering outdoors.' Repeated aftershocks continued terrorizing residents hours after the initial quake, complicating rescue efforts and keeping the population in sustained panic.

Katastrofalni događaj pogodio je područje 35 km sjeverozapadno od Herata u subotu, s jačinom od 6,3 stepena prema podacima američkih geologa. article_content: By Dan Bloom. A boutique clothing label allegedly used by crime boss Terry Adams to hide illicit funds - including the blue satin suit he wore to court - has become central to a High Court battle. N1 Angel, which claims to outfit celebrities including Brazilian footballers Thiago Silva and Neymar Jr, faces scrutiny as prosecutors argue the £400-suit brand run by Adams' wife serves as a front for concealing criminal proceeds. Adams, listed as N1 Angel's head designer, gained attention when photographed wearing one of his flamboyant designs outside court. The company promoted images of Adams in the 'coming soon' blue suit on social media. He seeks to void £628,000 remaining from a 2007 conviction for money laundering, claiming financial hardship - despite prosecutors citing luxury expenditures including £12,000 dental work, £3,850 spa membership, and £15,000 dining bills. Prosecutor Kennedy Talbot told the court N1 Angel isn't a 'legitimate business.' The Adams family, once among Britain's most feared crime syndicates, allegedly maintained wealth through criminal enterprises. Ruth Adams defended the brand's authenticity, stating she hired her husband for his fashion sense while admitting: 'I live above my means.' The hearing continues as authorities pursue £628,497 in unpaid penalties from Adams' 2007 conviction.

article_content: Scientists have observed the onset of a seven-year autumn season at Titan's south pole, Saturn's largest moon. The detection of an unidentified ice cloud formation suggests a reversal in the moon's global atmospheric circulation pattern. NASA's Cassini spacecraft data shows this phenomenon mirrors previous observations from Titan's north pole, where similar clouds are now dissipating with the arrival of spring. Donald Jennings of NASA stated: 'This specific ice cloud type correlates with Titan's winter conditions. Its first appearance outside the north pole marks a significant atmospheric shift.' Cassini initially documented atmospheric patterns where warm southern air migrated northward, cooling to form ice clouds. Researchers anticipated this circulation reversal as Titan's seasonal temperatures shifted, with the northern transition occurring in August 2009. Early 2012 data revealed initial signs of atmospheric change, including a developing southern polar vortex. The definitive ice cloud formation was confirmed in July 2012, as detailed in a December 2012 Astrophysical Journal Letters study. Carrie Anderson explained: 'The delayed cloud formation aligns with atmospheric processes - gas accumulation, air subsidence, and ice condensation under specific shadow conditions.' F. Michael Flasar drew parallels to Earth's climate: 'Titan's polar phenomena resemble Earth's ozone hole dynamics. While terrestrial polar clouds facilitate ozone-depleting chemistry, Titan's equivalent processes remain unknown, underscoring the need for continued study.'

Donald Jennings iz NASA-e izjavio je: 'Ovaj specifični tip ledenih oblaka povezujemo s zimskim uvjetima na Titanu. article_content: Recent U.S. research reveals significant trends in smartphone user behavior. Approximately 20% of Android users switched to iPhones between June 2012 and 2013, according to a Consumer Intelligence Research Partners (CIPR) study of 2,000 participants. The data highlights demographic differences: Apple users typically fall into younger age brackets (69% under 34), with over a third holding advanced degrees and earning £75,000 to £150,000 annually - notably higher than Samsung users. While Apple attracted 33% more customers from Samsung than vice versa during the study period, Samsung dominated first-time smartphone buyers. The Korean manufacturer captured 37% of this group compared to Apple's 26%. Market analysis shows Samsung shipped twice as many devices as Apple in mid-2013, claiming 27.7% of global phone sales and generating £3.4 billion operating profit in Q2 alone. The report also examines user personalities through brand loyalty patterns: iPhone owners reportedly spend more on personal grooming, while Android users show stronger practical skills. BlackBerry users emerged as high earners with stable relationships. In 2013 customer satisfaction rankings, Samsung's Galaxy S III and Note II scored 84/100 on the American Customer Satisfaction Index, slightly outperforming Apple's iPhones which scored 81-82 points.

article_content: Bee populations are declining globally due to colony collapse disorder, with new research identifying parasitic Varroa mites as a key factor. These mites have dramatically accelerated the spread of the deadly deformed wing virus (DWV) in honey bees. A University of Sheffield study in Hawaii revealed that Varroa infestation increased DWV prevalence from 10% to 100% in local bee populations, while viral loads surged by a millionfold. The research team, led by Professor Stephen Martin, observed that a single DWV strain became globally dominant through mite transmission. While pesticides and environmental factors remain considerations, virologist Ian Jones from the University of Reading confirms the mite-virus combination appears central to colony collapse. Experts worldwide stress the urgent need for beekeepers to control Varroa infestations, particularly given bees' crucial role as pollinators for numerous food crops across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Ove grinje dramatično su ubrzale širenje smrtonosnog virusa deformiranih krila (DWV) kod medonosnih pčela. Istraživanje Sveučilišta Sheffield na Havajima otkrilo je da je zaraza Varroa grinjama povećala učestalost DWV-a s 10% na 100% u lokalnim pčelinjim zajednicama, uz milijunstru porast količine virusa. Istraživački tim pod vodstvom profesora Stephena Martina utvrdio je da je jedan soj DWV-a postao globalno dominantan zahvaljujući prijenosu putem grinja. Iako se pesticidi i okolišni čimbenici još uvijek razmatraju, virolog Ian Jones sa Sveučilišta Reading potvrđuje da je kombinacija grinja i virusa ključni uzročnik kolapsa zajednica. article_content: (CNN) -- Emergency crews erected sandbag barriers Tuesday across the Midwest as the National Weather Service warned of potential record flooding in the Mississippi and Ohio river valleys. Widespread major flooding is anticipated in southern Missouri, southern Illinois, Indiana, western Kentucky, northern Arkansas and parts of Oklahoma, according to Noreen Schwein of the NWS Central Region headquarters. Missouri, Illinois and Kentucky have declared states of emergency, with National Guard troops deployed for levee reinforcement and sandbag operations. Indiana mobilized 80 prison inmates to assist in flood-prone Gibson County. A Poplar Bluff, Missouri levee failure forced over 6,000 evacuations in Butler County, while Bell City schools closed early due to rising waters. The Army Corps of Engineers considers the Birds Point-New Madrid Floodway a critical 'safety valve' for managing Mississippi River overflow. Paducah, Kentucky suspended garbage collection to focus on floodgate installations ahead of predicted 61-year high river levels. The Ohio River at Cairo, IL is forecast to crest at 61 feet on May 3 - 18 inches above the 1937 record. Meteorologists attribute flooding to upper Midwest snowmelt combined with 8-17 inches of rainfall in affected areas. An additional 3-5 inches of rain expected in coming days may exacerbate conditions, though a downstream snowmelt 'bulge' currently in Iowa isn't predicted to increase peak levels.

Paducah (Kentucky) privremeno je obustavio odvoz smeća kako bi se usredotočio na postavljanje protupoplavnih brana pred predviđenim porastom rijeke na najvišu razinu u 61 godini.
